facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine back to Warwick the smith, in exchange for his loan of the mithril chain shirt.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's armor, to him; Warwick holds the party's plate armor as collateral until it comes back. No return date was set.
Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt over his leather armor. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells. The shirt is on loan from Warwick.

A natural-looking cave-in seals the entrance to the Dwarven mine, which is marked on the treasure map beside a burnt cabin at the foot of a hill. This blocks getting the metal Warwick needs. It can be dug through, and Dunk has already broken partway in. Warwick believes there is metal inside; the seven dwarves who worked the mine are not expected to put up armed resistance.
